move: ordered Bayer dither to four colours, matrix crawls, lit sphere orbits
how: A 320x180 canvas upscaled with image-rendering pixelated draws a scene each frame: a diagonal violet gradient whose midpoint sweeps, a large sphere whose specular highlight circles it once per D while the sphere sways, six small orbs orbiting it, and the word DITHER. The frame is then quantised through a 4x4 Bayer matrix to a four-colour palette (near-black, purple, coral, cream); the matrix offset steps by frame index so the dither pattern crawls like animated noise. All scene motion is periodic in D and the crawl returns to zero at 120 frames.
adapt: Replace drawScene with the product image or logo drawn at low res, change the four palette entries and the word; raise the canvas size for finer dots. Keep the frame-indexed matrix crawl so the pattern feels alive.
port: mount(el, shot) creates the low-res canvas and offscreen scene canvas; animate(el, shot, D) returns a timeline with one linear progress tween over D whose onUpdate draws the scene and applies the dither, replacing fx.register. No GSAP is loaded in the original.
caveats: does not load gsap; the port adds it for the progress tween
per-pixel loop is small at 320x180 but grows quadratically with resolution
